title: 1. Hand Normal / Foot Normal (雙手正常 / 雙腳正常)
text:
1. Optimal and healthy sudomotor function in both upper and lower extremities (Hands > 60 μs, Feet > 60 μs).
2. No evidence of systemic metabolic neuropathy, autonomic dysfunction, or localized nerve entrapment.
3. Microcirculation and small fiber nerve health are excellent. Continue current healthy lifestyle maintenance.

title: 2. Hand Normal / Foot Moderate (雙手正常 / 雙腳中度異常)
text:
1. Normal sudomotor function in bilateral upper extremities (Hands > 60 μs).
2. Moderate sudomotor dysfunction in bilateral lower extremities (Feet 40-60 μs).
3. This pattern is consistent with early-stage, length-dependent systemic/metabolic stress (e.g., pre-diabetes).
4. Highly reversible stage. Lifestyle modifications and routine metabolic screening are recommended.

title: 3. Hand Normal / Foot Severe (雙手正常 / 雙腳嚴重異常)
text:
1. Normal sudomotor function in bilateral upper extremities (Hands > 60 μs) with severe sudomotor dysfunction in lower extremities (Feet < 40 μs).
2. Classic presentation of advanced length-dependent peripheral polyneuropathy (e.g., Diabetic Sensorimotor Polyneuropathy).
3. High risk of anhidrosis and loss of protective sensation (LOPS) in the feet.
4. Strict metabolic control and diabetic foot care protocols are strongly mandated to prevent ulceration.

title: 4. Hand Moderate / Foot Normal (雙手中度異常 / 雙腳正常)
text:
1. Moderate sudomotor dysfunction in bilateral upper extremities (Hands 40-60 μs) with normal function in lower extremities (Feet > 60 μs).
2. This atypical, non-length-dependent pattern rules out advanced systemic metabolic neuropathy.
3. Findings strongly suggest localized, mild bilateral upper extremity strain, occupational overuse, cervical muscle tension, or benign skin dryness.
4. Postural/ergonomic adjustments are recommended.

title: 5. Hand Moderate / Foot Moderate (雙手中度異常 / 雙腳中度異常)
text:
1. Generalized moderate sudomotor dysfunction across all four extremities (Hands & Feet 40-60 μs).
2. Indicates early-stage, reversible systemic microcirculatory or metabolic stress (e.g., metabolic syndrome, chronic fatigue).
3. Patient is in a highly reversible clinical window. Comprehensive metabolic screening and lifestyle modifications (aerobic exercise, diet) are recommended.

title: 6. Hand Moderate / Foot Severe (雙手中度異常 / 雙腳嚴重異常)
text:
1. Moderate sudomotor dysfunction in upper extremities (Hands 40-60 μs) and severe dysfunction in lower extremities (Feet < 40 μs).
2. Indicative of progressive, advanced length-dependent polyneuropathy where distal degeneration is advancing proximally to the upper limbs.
3. High risk for foot ulceration and worsening systemic autonomic failure. Urgent medical intervention for strict metabolic control is required.

title: 7. Hand Severe / Foot Normal (雙手嚴重異常 / 雙腳正常)
text:
1. Severe sudomotor dysfunction in bilateral upper extremities (Hands < 40 μs) with fully preserved, normal function in lower extremities (Feet > 60 μs).
2. This stark, atypical non-length-dependent pattern points heavily to severe bilateral upper-body structural/mechanical pathology rather than systemic disease.
3. Highly suspicious for central cervical spine pathology (e.g., cervical stenosis) or severe bilateral Carpal Tunnel Syndrome. Urgent neurological/orthopedic evaluation of the cervical spine and arms is recommended.

title: 8. Hand Severe / Foot Moderate (雙手嚴重異常 / 雙腳中度異常)
text:
1. Severe sudomotor dysfunction in upper extremities (Hands < 40 μs) combined with moderate dysfunction in lower extremities (Feet 40-60 μs).
2. Suggests a dual pathology: underlying mild-to-moderate systemic/metabolic stress compounded by a severe bilateral upper extremity nerve compromise.
3. Urgent evaluation of the cervical spine and upper limbs (EMG/NCS) is needed, alongside routine metabolic screening.

title: 9. Hand Severe / Foot Severe (雙手嚴重異常 / 雙腳嚴重異常)
text:
1. Global severe sudomotor dysfunction across all four extremities (Hands < 40 μs, Feet < 40 μs).
2. Indicates profound, advanced systemic small fiber polyneuropathy and microcirculatory failure.
3. Extreme risk of generalized anhidrosis, loss of protective sensation (LOPS), and painless ulceration.
4. Urgent systemic medical workup, strict metabolic control, autonomic screening, and high-risk protective foot/hand care protocols are absolutely mandatory.

On a thyroid ultrasound, a nodule is classified into one of five categories:

- benign pattern (0% risk): no biopsy
- very low suspicion pattern (<3% risk): biopsy if ≥2 cm (or ultrasound observation)
- low suspicion pattern (5-10% risk): biopsy if ≥1.5 cm
- intermediate suspicion pattern (10-20% risk): biopsy if ≥1 cm
- high suspicion pattern (>70-90% risk): biopsy if ≥1 cm
- completely **cystic nodules with well-defined walls
- spongiform nodules and nodules with interspersed cystic spaces, without any of the features in more suspicious patterns

- isoechoic or hyperechoic nodule
- partially cystic nodule with a peripheral solid component
- none of the following features:
    - microcalcifications (see other points below)
    - irregular margins
    - extrathyroidal extension
    - taller than wide

- hypoechoic solid nodule with smooth margins
- none of the following features:
    - microcalcifications (see other points below)
    - irregular margins
    - extrathyroidal extension
    - taller than wide

- solid hypoechoic nodule (or solid hypoechoic component of a partially cystic nodule), with at least one of these features:
    - microcalcifications (see other points below)
    - irregular margins (infiltrative, microlobulated)
    - extrathyroidal extension
    - taller than wide
    - rim calcifications with an extrusive soft tissue component
    - lymphadenopathy
Scoring is determined from five categories of ultrasound findings (figure 2). The higher the cumulative score, the higher the TR (TI-RADS) level and the likelihood of malignancy.
One score is assigned from each of the following categories:

- **composition:** (choose one)
    - cystic or completely cystic *: 0 points
    - spongiform *: 0 points
    - mixed cystic and solid: 1 point
    - solid or almost completely solid: 2 points
- **echogenicity:** (choose one)
    - anechoic: 0 points
    - hyper- or isoechoic: 1 point
    - hypoechoic: 2 points
    - very hypoechoic: 3 points
- **shape:** (choose one) (assessed on the transverse plane)
    - wider than tall: 0 points
    - taller than wide: 3 points
- **margin:** (choose one)
    - smooth: 0 points
    - ill-defined: 0 points
    - lobulated/irregular: 2 points
    - extra-thyroidal extension: 3 points
Any and all findings in the final category are also added to the other four scores.

- **echogenic foci:** (choose one or more)
    - none: 0 points
    - large comet-tail artifact: 0 points
    - macrocalcifications: 1 point
    - peripheral/rim calcifications: 2 points
    - punctate echogenic foci: 3 points

- **TR1**: 0 points
    - benign
- **TR2**: 2 points
    - not suspicious
- **TR3**: 3 points
    - mildly suspicious
- **TR4**: 4-6 points
    - moderately suspicious
- **TR5**: ≥7 points
    - highly suspicious

- **TR1**: no FNA required
- **TR2**: no FNA required
- **TR3**: ≥1.5 cm follow up, ≥2.5 cm FNA
    - follow up: 1, 3 and 5 years
- **TR4**: ≥1.0 cm follow up, ≥1.5 cm FNA
    - follow up: 1, 2, 3 and 5 years
- **TR5**: ≥0.5 cm follow up, ≥1.0 cm FNA
    - annual follow up for up to 5 years

Protocol (Mixed meal test for suspected postprandial hypoglycemia & 72 hour fasting test)
1. 吃飯前先抽病人空腹血糖、insulin、C-peptide
2. 食用疑似造成病人餐後產生低血糖之食物，之後開始NPO， 但可以喝水
3. Check one touch sugar every 30 mins 直到 < 55 mg/dL，此時抽血測 serum glucose 確定真正小於 55 mg/dL 之後才送出 insulin, C-peptite
4. 若檢查當中出現嚴重低血糖症狀則直接抽 blood glucose, insulin, C-peptite 並中止檢查,給予病人補充糖分。
5. Check one touch sugar every 30 mins POCT 持續3小時後，如果沒有發生嚴重低血糖症狀或POCT < 55mg/dl，改成Q4H測POCT(進入連續72小時空腹測試)

6. Check one-touch glucose Q4H 直到 < 60 mg/dL，之後 check one-touch glucose Q1H 直到 <55 mg/dL，此時一起抽 plasma glucose+C-peptide+insulin+cortisol+hGH，但是 C-peptide+insulin+cortisol+hGH 先不要送出去，等到 plasma glucose data 確認為 <55 mg/dl 再送出
7. 若發生嚴重低血糖症狀(consiousness change)，抽C-peptide+insulin+cortisol+hGH 並補充糖分
